periods.time: After the massacre at Rebellion headquarters

name.zh: 月影读取解放军本部过去

periods.summary: Kozo Kazamatsuri brings Tsukikage, Rinna, Sara, and Charlotte to the devastated Rebellion base. Tsukikage uses Moon Heaven Jewel to reconstruct the massacre and learns Or-Gaule, Naseem, Ein, and B.B. plan to destroy Quedland and Vermillion. Kozo and Tsukikage decide to inform the League while preserving Rebellion as a third force, but communications fail and SCION's Abraham Carter approaches in armed helicopters.
periods.cause: Kozo needs reliable information about what happened and why Or-Gaule is acting independently, especially in relation to Tsukikage's prior predictions.
periods.process: The Kazamatsuri party surveys severed mountaintops and corpses. Tsukikage projects the headquarters' past, witnessing the entire massacre and Or-Gaule's new plan. Rinna and Sara realize Ikki and Stella may be in Vermillion and try to warn them, but phones cannot connect. A Rebellion lookout then reports incoming SCION helicopters led by Abraham Carter.
periods.outcome: The protagonists' wider allies know the identity and destination of Or-Gaule's faction, but immediate warning and League coordination are disrupted. The Union begins moving on Rebellion's weakened headquarters.
periods.significance: Connects the local Vermillion crisis to global balance-of-power collapse and explains why League intervention begins later.
